commands:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/eastwest-traffic-gen.service > /dev/null << 'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=East-West traffic generator

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/eastwest-traffic-gen.sh
UNITEOF

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/eastwest-traffic-gen.timer > /dev/null << 'TIMEREOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run East-West traffic generator every minute

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30
OnUnitActiveSec=60

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
TIMEREOF
